def transform(grid):
    # Frames are hollow rectangles. Copy fill pattern from the small 3x3 symbol
    # into each larger hollow frame, scaled to the frame interior.
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    R,C=len(a),len(a[0])
    # find rectangular color frames by bounding box of each non-background color
    bg=max(set(x for row in a for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in a))
    from collections import defaultdict
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for i,row in enumerate(a):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v!=bg: pts[v].append((i,j))
    boxes=[]
    for col,p in pts.items():
        r0=min(i for i,j in p);r1=max(i for i,j in p);c0=min(j for i,j in p);c1=max(j for i,j in p)
        # closed rectangle boundary, with empty interior
        if len(p)==2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0-1) and r1-r0>=2 and c1-c0>=2:
            boxes.append((col,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    # smallest boundary frame acts as pattern; 3x3 source pattern with its own color
    src=min(boxes,key=lambda b:(b[2]-b[1]+1)*(b[4]-b[3]+1))
    scol,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=src
    pattern=[[a[sr0+1+i][sc0+1+j] for j in range(sc1-sc0-1)] for i in range(sr1-sr0-1)]
    for col,r0,r1,c0,c1 in boxes:
        if (col,r0,r1,c0,c1)==src: continue
        h=r1-r0-1;w=c1-c0-1
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                # stretch source interior pattern by nearest proportional mapping
                pi=min(len(pattern)-1, i*len(pattern)//h)
                pj=min(len(pattern[0])-1, j*len(pattern[0])//w)
                v=pattern[pi][pj]
                if v!=bg and v!=scol: a[r0+1+i][c0+1+j]=v
    return a
PY
